biography:
I am an experienced Datacenter Professional, understanding the technical, commercial, environmental as well as social needs to develop, build and operate Datacenters. As a spearhead I searched, acquired and developed Hyperscale Datacenter sites with a total of more than 1 GW in D/A/CH Region since 2020. Negotiated and closed deals with single values up to €500m. I have set up businesses and built teams cross border. Also partnered with municipalities and local authorities to create and maintain deep relationships and develop sustainability projects, e.g. waste heat reusage or solar power. 
Having a 30 year+ track record in HVAC Business, I also supported Companies reaching their targets in terms of sales development, organisation and processes. As an experienced Sales and Management Professional in international Companies I was focused on HVAC in Datacenter Market as well as other  businesses. Prepared to support in building Teams, developing Markets, Products and People. Supporting UK/Ireland or US based Companies in entering German DC Market, finding Properties for DC build, and founding legal entities. Highly motivated, creative and adaptive with high sense of responsibility, oriented in a system of Values. Goal oriented team player, depending on circumstances either pragmatic or strategic acting. Strong knowledge and understanding of cooling and Datacenter business, combined with a reliable network and a solid reputation. Experienced in leading cross border teams in direct and dotted line, with high double digit m€ budget responsibility. Connecting DC Companies with the right supplier regarding Cooling, Busbars, UPS, Racks, Raised Floor and Waterproofing/flatroofing.
